package com.acme.invoicing.service;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.any;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.verify;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.when;

import com.acme.invoicing.domain.Invoice;
import com.acme.invoicing.domain.InvoiceStatus;
import com.acme.invoicing.exception.InvoiceNotFoundException;
import com.acme.invoicing.repository.InvoiceRepository;
import com.acme.invoicing.web.dto.IssueInvoiceRequest;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.Clock;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.ZoneId;
import java.util.Optional;
import org.junit.Before;
import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.mockito.Mock;
import org.mockito.junit.MockitoJUnitRunner;

/**
 * Renamed from InvoiceServiceTest in CR-3310. Still JUnit 4 (vintage engine).
 */
@RunWith(MockitoJUnitRunner.class)
public class InvoiceServiceImplTest {

    private static final ZoneId SGT = ZoneId.of("Asia/Singapore");
    private static final String NO = "INV-202610-0001230";

    @Mock
    private InvoiceRepository invoiceRepository;

    private InvoiceServiceImpl service;

    @Before
    public void setUp() {
        Clock fixed = Clock.fixed(Instant.parse("2026-10-15T02:00:00Z"), SGT);
        service = new InvoiceServiceImpl(invoiceRepository, fixed);
    }

    @Test
    public void issue_assignsNextNumberAndDefaultTerms() {
        when(invoiceRepository.currentSequence("INV")).thenReturn(122L);
        when(invoiceRepository.save(any(Invoice.class))).thenAnswer(inv -> inv.getArgument(0));

        Invoice issued = service.issue(new IssueInvoiceRequest("C-001", new BigDecimal("250.00"), 0));

        assertEquals(NO, issued.getInvoiceNo());
        assertEquals(LocalDate.of(2026, 11, 14), issued.getDueDate());
    }

    @Test(expected = InvoiceNotFoundException.class)
    public void findByNumber_unknown_throwsNotFound() {
        when(invoiceRepository.findByInvoiceNo(NO)).thenReturn(Optional.empty());

        service.findByNumber(NO);
    }

    @Test(expected = Exception.class)
    public void findByNumber_malformed() {
        service.findByNumber("not-an-invoice");
    }

    @Test
    public void recordPayment_fullAmount_marksPaid() {
        Invoice open = openInvoice("100.00");
        when(invoiceRepository.findByInvoiceNo(NO)).thenReturn(Optional.of(open));
        when(invoiceRepository.save(open)).thenReturn(open);

        Invoice paid = service.recordPayment(NO, new BigDecimal("100.00"));

        assertEquals(InvoiceStatus.PAID, paid.getStatus());
        assertEquals(0, paid.getOutstanding().signum());
        verify(invoiceRepository).save(open);
    }

    @Test
    public void testPartialPayment() {
        Invoice open = openInvoice("100.00");
        when(invoiceRepository.findByInvoiceNo(NO)).thenReturn(Optional.of(open));
        when(invoiceRepository.save(open)).thenReturn(open);

        Invoice result = service.recordPayment(NO, new BigDecimal("40.00"));

        assertEquals(InvoiceStatus.PARTIALLY_PAID, result.getStatus());
        assertTrue(result.getOutstanding().compareTo(new BigDecimal("60.00")) == 0);
    }

    @Test(expected = IllegalArgumentException.class)
    public void recordPayment_overpayment_isRejected() {
        Invoice open = openInvoice("100.00");
        when(invoiceRepository.findByInvoiceNo(NO)).thenReturn(Optional.of(open));

        service.recordPayment(NO, new BigDecimal("100.01"));
    }

    private static Invoice openInvoice(final String amount) {
        Invoice invoice = new Invoice(NO, "C-001", new BigDecimal(amount), LocalDate.of(2026, 11, 14));
        invoice.setStatus(InvoiceStatus.OPEN);
        return invoice;
    }
}
